basic_info.description:
Stunning top floor condo with views, just steps to Precita Park. It features three spacious bedrooms including a primary suite, two and a half bathrooms, two private balconies, in-unit laundry, parking and more. It offers an open kitchen with stainless steel appliances, and a renovated design. The living area is graced with decorative moldings, recessed lighting, cozy fireplace, and built-in speakers creating an inviting ambiance. Large windows with plenty of natural light and captivating city views. Primary bedroom comes with own outdoor space and ensuite bath with a separate shower and jet-tub. Enjoy the convenience of two large closets including a walk-in, and ample storage options throughout. Two other bedrooms are privately situated on the level below, both with large closets and built-ins. Other premium features include hardwood flooring, new carpeting, intercom system and more. The secure garage, shared with only one other neighbor, offers on-site parking and additional storage space. Location is steps to Precita Park, local cafes, produce stores, hiking trails, top-rated restaurants, and easy transit & highway access.

Owner pays for garbage disposal. Tenant pays for other utilities (water, gas, electricity).
